name: Emendo — AI Bookkeeping
description: Full UX design for an AI bookkeeping assistant. Translated complex LLM outputs into intuitive financial dashboards for non-technical users.
detailedContent:
Product Design & Challenge

Bookkeeping platforms often overwhelm users with dense financial data. For Emendo, the goal was to transform multi-step accounting workflows into conversational AI prompts and clear visual dashboards.

Design Solutions

  • Created an end-to-end Figma prototype covering receipt processing, ledger updates, and AI query flows.
  • Built an adaptive light/dark UI design system tailored for high data readability.
